_meta.note: SYNTHESIZED, and the word is load-bearing: no line here was captured off a wire. The remote agent is a kiro-cli acp child inside an AgentCore container, and neither the container (WP1) nor the bridge that would carry its frames (WP3) exists at this commit, so there was nothing to record. The frames are written from the parsers in src/kiro_crew/acp/_dispatch.py, which is what this corpus asserts about: that the dispatch layer classifies the seven required frame classes correctly when they arrive under this backend id. They are ALSO shaped from what Spike C observed on a real kiro-cli acp child (an INTEGER protocolVersion where the local kiro client sends a date string, and per-turn credits inside the agent's own messages), so the shapes are not invented -- but the transport they are claimed to have travelled is not yet built. Read this as a shape assertion under a registered id, never as evidence about a remote turn. agent_version is 'unmeasured' because no remote agent has been run through Crew.
